scheme_name: Financial Assistance To Non-School Going Disabled Children Scheme
other_conditions: Physical disability in the age group 0‑18 years
Child is not able to attend formal education, training, etc., due to the disability

Medical certificate issued by the Civil Surgeon specifying the disability (mental retardation with IQ ≤50 or ≥70% disability, cerebral palsy, autism, multiple disabilities with ≥70% disability, or orthopedic disability with 100% disability such as myopathy, paraplegia, quadriplegia)
Applicant and close relatives/parents have income less than the Minimum Wages and are unable to financially support the child, with proof of income verified by the competent authority
Domicile of Haryana and residence in Haryana for the last three years at the time of application
benefits_summary: A monthly financial assistance of ₹2150 is provided to every eligible non‑school‑going disabled child in the applicant’s family.
documents_required: Medical Certificate issued by the Civil Surgeon
Proof of income (income certificate) verified by the competent authority
